label: Order in pending cases
caption: WHOLE WOMAN’S HEALTH, ET AL. V. JACKSON, JUDGE, ETC., ET AL.
text: The motion of respondents in No. 21-463 for divided argument is denied. The motion of respondents in No. 21-588 (21A85) for divided argument is granted.
